candidates.description: These tokens represent characters, matras, and conjuncts from the Devanagari script used for Indic languages.
This vector represents Hindi consonant characters combined with the vowel sign 'u' (u-kar/matra) in the Devanagari script.
This vector activates for common Hindi nominal suffixes and consonant clusters.
This vector is related to letters and characters from the Devanagari script used for Hindi and other Indian languages.
This feature vector represents common subword tokens and characters used in Hindi text.
This vector activates on common Hindi character clusters, morphs, and inflectional suffixes.
These tokens represent common Hindi vowel matras (diacritics) and associated punctuation marks.
This feature vector activates strongly for characters and subword tokens belonging to the Devanagari script.
This vector represents Hindi character sequences and subword components involving the consonant 'व' (va).
This vector represents common Hindi vowel sign suffixes and character combinations used in word inflection.
